rules.statement: A defendant is not entitled to bring in the vendors of land as parties defendants in an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code solely to obtain a rectification of the deed on which he relies, even if the error was discovered only after the institution of the case.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this case if the motion of the defendant is allowed he in reality, becomes the plaintiff in a distinct cause of action against the new parties and the resulting position is the same as if two plaintiffs have joined in respect of distinct causes of action, and what is more against two different defendants."
